verdict.rationale: The evidence only glances at this story. Salesforce markets "engagement built directly into your CRM" and "Built-in Sales Flows," and one community user reports setting up a timed email in SFDC within minutes. Nothing documents email templates or multi-step prospect sequences specifically. Email sync (docs-8) is an adjacent capability and earns no credit. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of templated email sending, multi-step sequence/cadence building, sending to prospects from records, and independent corroboration beyond a single anecdote.
